headline: List every deal, login and decision that only lives in your head, and watch a live dollar exposure and ranked action list build as you fill it in.

episode.title: Jensen Huang Is Back: Inside NVIDIA’s $1 Trillion Comeback After 11 Days Out | EP #315

history.summary:
A tight, self-contained single-file tool that matches the opportunity brief closely: a scored, ranked key-person-risk register with a live exposure dial, a printable action list, and an honestly-labeled example company, all backed by a transparent bundled scoring rule shown on the page. The math checks out end-to-end (per-row scores, average exposure dial, two-week revenue total all reconcile against the example data), there's no fabricated real-world figure, and mobile/print/local-storage all work as described. The only rough edges are a mislabeled example flag after a manual edit and missing programmatic labels/text for accessibility — both easy follow-ups, not blockers.</parameter>
